A 3D printing training course provides you with the knowledge to produce components, models, and functional designs using modern additive manufacturing processes. You will learn the entire process from digital design to the finished 3D-printed product. The Mach-3D Academy places emphasis on practical relevance, industrial quality, and the professional applicability of your skills.

The advanced training course is suitable for career changers, job seekers, soldiers in the German Armed Forces Career Service (BfD), technicians, designers, engineers, and anyone who wants to gain a foothold in industry or product development. You can start even without prior knowledge and will be trained step by step to become a 3D printing specialist.

At the Mach 3D Academy, you will learn about FDM, SLA, and SLS as well as their industrial applications. You will discover how to optimize components constructively, aesthetically, and for manufacturability for each process.

Parts of the training are conducted online, especially theoretical content and CAD training. For practical sessions, you work on-site at the Mach-3D Academy to get to know real machines and industrial materials.

Typical professions are: 3D printing technician, additive manufacturing designer, prototyping specialist, production technician, model maker, workshop technician, or technical assistant in R&D departments. Many graduates work in mechanical engineering, medicine, product development, and Industry 4.0.
